Find the projection of the intersection between the ellipsoid (x−2)23+y26+z212=1 and the plane z−y=3 onto the xy-plane.

a
(x−2)22/3+(y+1)22=1.
b
(x−2)21/2+y23/2=1.
c
(x−2)23/2+(y+1)22=1.
d
(x−2)23/2+(y+1)21/2=1.
e
(x−2)22/3+y21/2=1.
Don't Know
